thematic_origin.work: قل سيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف بدأ الخلق

supersession_reasons.issue: R06 attributed a naming-capacity formulation to al-Raghib without a directly verified edition and page.
supersession_reasons.correction: The attribution is excluded. Abu Hayyan is the fifth verified exegetical source, while Ibn Ashur carries the explicit naming-and-expression-capacity discussion.

supersession_reasons.issue: A15 was a synthetic grouping of two papers rather than an independent source.
supersession_reasons.correction: A15 is now Hewitt and Liang's primary control-task probing paper, DOI 10.18653/v1/D19-1275.

supersession_reasons.issue: The planning graph used one-way support arrays and mixed support with opposition.
supersession_reasons.correction: The verified register contains reciprocal claim-to-source and source-to-claim support and qualification arrays.

supersession_reasons.issue: The planning register was written before source-by-source primary verification.
supersession_reasons.correction: It must not be cited, published, or treated as the current evidence manifest.

rules: Do not restore the retired claims or source list from git history into a public article.
Do not treat the author's manuscript as Qur'anic exegesis or empirical AI evidence.
Do not claim that the public article has been rewritten until both Arabic and English editions pass the release gates.
Do not use the 2026 frontier preprint as evidence of phenomenal consciousness.
Use the verified claim-evidence register as the sole machine-readable research source of truth for the rebuild.
